story.fullStory:
Glass Tiger's "Don't Forget Me When I'm Gone" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Don't Forget Me (When I'm Gone)" is a song by Canadian rock band Glass Tiger.

It was released in 1986 as the lead from their debut album, The Thin Red Line (1986).

The song reached number one in Canada and number two in the United States.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

evidence.recording:
4 recording notes captured

Background In 1985, Glass Tiger chose Jim Vallance to produce the band's debut album.

At the time, Vallance was primarily known as a songwriter, having written most frequently (and successfully) with Bryan Adams (who can be heard providing background vocals towards the end of this song).

The band has released five studio albums.

In 1986, Glass Tiger released its first album, The Thin Red Line; it was produced by Jim Vallance (who co-wrote two songs) and Bryan Adams made a memorable vocal cameo on the lead single "Don't Forget Me (When I'm Gone)".
